# Command-surface ratchet (ADR 0016). Number of visible top-level commands the
# v1.5 core binary registers; internal/repoqa/command_surface_test.go requires it
# to EQUAL the real count (TestCommandSurfaceBudgetIsTight) and never to exceed the
# canon verb list (TestCanonCeiling).
#
# 2026-10-18 (P7-CANON-17): 52 -> 20, the v1.5 canon. Every other former top-level
# command is a shim, a move, a plugin break-out or a mounted plugin family (see
# .github/wiki/Command-Canon.md). Editing this number needs an ADR 0016 amendment.
20
